findings.title: StorageClass cannot provide the access mode
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim shared asks for access mode ReadWriteMany, which the provisioner of StorageClass standard cannot provide: failed to provision volume with StorageClass "standard": NodePath only supports ReadWriteOnce and ReadWriteOncePod (1.22+) access modes

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc shared -n kd-pvc-access-mode -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'

evidence.what: claim asks for access modes ReadWriteMany
evidence.command: kubectl get pvc shared -n kd-pvc-access-mode -o jsonpath='{.spec.accessModes}'

evidence.detail: failed to provision volume with StorageClass "standard": NodePath only supports ReadWriteOnce and ReadWriteOncePod (1.22+) access modes

findings.fix: Ask for an access mode the class supports (usually ReadWriteOnce), or use a StorageClass whose storage can be shared (NFS, CephFS, a cloud file store) for ReadWriteMany. A claim's access modes cannot be changed: recreate it.
